summary: AkzoNobel filed a 6-K furnishing an update on the UK CMA's Phase 1 review of its proposed merger with Axalta Coating Systems. The CMA identified competition concerns solely in UK vehicle refinish coatings. AkzoNobel and Axalta intend to offer the same remedy agreed with the European Commission: divestment of AkzoNobel's European VR coatings business, including the UK operations. No price or premium is disclosed. The combined company would have roughly $17 billion in revenue, and the parties target completion by early 2027. Watch the CMA Phase 2 referral risk and whether the EC remedy package suffices.
